## Introduction

This R Markdown document demonstrates the **Paired t-Test** and explores the concept of **homogeneity of variances** in the context of dependent samples.  
Unlike the independent t-test, where we assume equal variances between two groups, the paired t-test focuses on the **differences** between paired observations (e.g., before and after a treatment).  

The steps below:
1. Generate two paired datasets representing “Before” and “After” measurements (weights before and after a diet).  
2. Compute the **difference scores** (`After - Before`).
3. Visualize the distribution of differences to assess consistency in variance (homogeneity).  
4. Conduct a **paired t-test** to determine if the mean difference is statistically significant.  
5. Check the **normality assumption** on the differences using the **Shapiro–Wilk test**.  

---

```{r paired-t-homogeneity, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ================================================
# Paired t-Test and Homogeneity of Variance Example
# ================================================

# Step 1: Define Before and After measurements
before <- c(72, 68, 75, 70, 80, 85, 77, 90, 65, 73)
after  <- c(70, 67, 72, 69, 78, 82, 74, 88, 63, 72)

# Step 2: Compute difference scores
diff <- after - before

# Step 3: Visualize the distribution of differences
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))  # Show two plots side-by-side
boxplot(diff,
        main = "Distribution of Weight Differences",
        ylab = "Difference (After - Before)",
        col = "blue", border = "gray30")

hist(diff,
     main = "Histogram of Weight Differences",
     xlab = "Difference (kg)",
     col = "red", border = "white")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))  # Reset layout

# Step 4: Conduct the paired t-test
t_test_result <- t.test(after, before, paired = TRUE)
t_test_result

# Step 5: Normality check on the difference scores
shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(diff)
shapiro_result

# Step 6: Display results summary
cat("Paired t-test p-value:", round(t_test_result$p.value, 4), "\n")
cat("Shapiro-Wilk p-value:", round(shapiro_result$p.value, 4), "\n")

if (t_test_result$p.value < 0.05) {
  cat("Conclusion: Significant difference detected (Reject H0)\n")
} else {
  cat("Conclusion: No significant difference (Fail to Reject H0)\n")
}

if (shapiro_result$p.value > 0.05) {
  cat("Normality assumption appears reasonable.\n")
} else {
  cat("Differences deviate from normality (consider nonparametric test).\n")
}
```
